terms.raw: 1 1/2 tbsp sweet paprika
5 lb / 2.5 kg American style pork ribs (, cut into individual ribs (to fit into one baking dish))
1 bottle dark beer ((About 12 oz / 375 ml. Stout, porter or a dark ale))
14 oz / 400g can crushed tomato
3.5 oz / 100g can Chipotle in Adobo Sauce (, chipotle and sauce (1/2 a standard can) (Note 1))
1 large onion ((brown, white or yellow), diced)
2 tbsp Tabasco sauce (, or other hot sauce. Adjust to taste.)
Fresh coriander/cilantro leaves
Lime wedges

terms.key: boneless skinless chicken breasts or thighs
terms.term: boneless skinless chicken breasts or thighs
terms.raw: 1 1/4 pounds boneless skinless chicken breasts or thighs (thinly sliced then cut into bite-sized pieces)
4 tablespoons low sodium soy sauce (plus additional to taste, divided)
1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar
2 tablespoons grapeseed oil or canola oil (divided)
6 ounces dry long noodles (such as soba (udon) noodles or whole wheat spaghetti or whole wheat linguine noodles)
6 cups thinly sliced vegetables
1 to 2 teaspoons sriracha or other hot sauce (or to taste)
1 bay leaf
1 medium sweet potato (peeled and cut into ½-inch dice (or swap Yukon gold or russet potato))
1/4 cup raisins (optional)
1 tablespoon plus 1 teaspoon sherry vinegar
For serving: cooked brown rice or steamed cauliflower rice
